engine_name: Healthy Weight programme engine (P3-35; FR3-97 to FR3-110, FR3-36): "where you are now" from the Healthy Weight Check engine ported to PHP (BMI 1 dp half-up; standard bands 18.5, 25, 30 and the lower cut-offs 23 and 27.5; waist-to-height 2 dp, not shown at BMI 35 or more; healthy range 18.45 x h2 rounded up to 22.95 or 24.95 x h2 rounded down, to 0.1 kg), the background choice D3-54, milestones (5 %, 10 %, top of the healthy range, the goal; weeks rounded up as P3-56), weekly drinks (days x drinks a time, "5 or more" = 5) at 130 kcal a pictured drink rounded to the nearest 10, the drinking card above 8 a week or at 5 or more a time, and the rule catalogue v1.3 section 9 rules (pace, steps, notes, reminders, food, plateau, focus blocks and the festival day map).
intended_use: Builds and adjusts a Healthy Weight member's plan from their saved measurements, answers and logs. Pure functions with no database; package P2 calls them and shows only owner-approved wording and content.
eligibility: Members on Healthy Weight with health consent. Not offered in pregnancy or breastfeeding, with an eating disorder, or under 18 (R-HW-SAFE-01); no BMI bands in pregnancy or under 18; no drink calorie figure with an eating-disorder flag.
sources: 04 Health Tools/Stage 3/P3-35-Where-You-Are-Now-Method-Sheet.md (signed 6 Nov 2026, D3-54 to D3-57; record Signoff-P3-35-Where-You-Are-Now.md).
Healthy Weight Check (FR2-39), signed off as AS-19 on 31 Oct 2026; frozen fixtures fixtures/healthy-weight/, oracle ORC-05.
Rule catalogue v1.3 section 9 (D3-58, D3-59): approvals/stage3/decision-rules.json.
Approved food-rule tags for recipes R-103 to R-176 (10 Nov 2026, FT-Q1 to FT-Q5 all A).
limitations: BMI and waist-to-height ratio are screening measures, not a diagnosis; self-reported measurements.
One pictured drink is an average (about 12.5 g of alcohol, 130 kcal); drinks differ.
The Healthy Weight Check itself is not changed; the port is proved equal on every frozen fixture.
regulatory_statement: Method sheet signed by the owner as clinical reviewer on 6 November 2026 (NFR3-14; D3-54 to D3-57); rules and templates signed as catalogue versions 1.2 (D3-58, 6 Nov 2026) , 1.3 (D3-59, 10 Nov 2026) and 1.3.1 (D3-60, 10 Nov 2026). General health information, not a diagnosis or a medical device. Frozen: any change needs a new decision.
licence: Lifeline Daily's own rules; BMI and waist-to-height thresholds from NICE NG246 and WHO.
